messages:
Aria V: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread — we need owners/timelines for the remediation tests. Focus areas: regression prompt set, nightly scaled load, small chaos drill for KV GC, and a recurring detection rule for the pattern we saw.
Liam H: I'll own the regression prompt set. Plan: extract failing traces, curate ~200 adversarial prompts, add 400 synthetic variants. Deliverable: PR with prompt json + eval harness by next Tue.
Noor A: I'll take the nightly scaled load job and the detection rule. Load spec: 2h at 180rps on staging with 20m high-spike. Detection: anomaly rule on token-rate + kv-gc pause metric. ETA infra PR by Fri.
PM-Rahul: Product needs estimated customer impact window. Can we promise a customer note by the follow-up Friday?
Aria V: Yes, aim to have a short one-paragraph comms draft ready the Friday after tests. I'll collate results and sign-off.
ops-bot: Created ticket TEST-9001 "Post-incident: remediation tests & detection" with Aria V, Liam H, Noor A assigned. Link: https://redwood.internal/TEST-9001
Liam H: Acceptance criteria suggestion: regression = no >2% drop in response-quality score across the adversarial bucket; tokenization edge-case = exact-match > 99.2%; load = p95 < 200ms and error-rate < 0.5%; chaos = no persistent KV corruption after 30m.
Noor A: Agreed. For the detection rule, propose: trigger if kv_gc_stall_count > 3 in 5m OR token_rate jump > 40% sustained >2m. Create an auto pager if both occur.
Aria V: Good. Chaos drill scope: simulate KV GC pause and worker restart sequence, but run against an isolated test-pool. Schedule Wed 04:00 UTC. Who can coordinate with eng-sre?
eng-sre-bot: eng-sre observers added; scheduled window Wed 04:00 UTC. See ENG-SRE calendar invite sent to Aria V, Noor A, Liam H.
Noor A: I'll prepare rollback steps for the chaos drill: kv-gc abort, kv snapshot restore, and worker recycle. Will paste commands in TEST-9001 beforehand.
Liam H: Also planning a small CI snippet to run the adversarial bucket as part of the nightly pipeline. Will add to .github/staging-ci.yaml:
```
- name: adversarial-regression
  run: ./evals/run_bucket --bucket=adversarial_incident --config=prod --threshold=0.98
```
Aria V: Timeline recap: Liam (prompts + eval harness) PR by Tue, Noor (load + detection + infra PR) by Fri, Aria (comms + runbook) draft by Thu. If any slips, tag TEST-9001 and ping me.
PM-Rahul: I'll review the comms and help prioritize prompts if product input is needed.
Liam H: One more ask 1 2: include a small replay script to reproduce the exact request sequence from the incident logs, that makes triage way faster. I'll add that to my PR.
Noor A: Adding telemetry: capture token-rate, kv_gc_pause_ms, worker-restart-count, and response-error-type. We'll surface those on the staging dashboard for the run.
Aria V: Perfect. I'll update TEST-9001 with owners and acceptance criteria now and link the calendar invites. Will post a short summary here after the first run. :white_check_mark:
